verdict.rationale: Datalab publishes a public REST API reference with endpoints for convert, extract, segment, agent processors, schema generation and health checks. It also serves an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec from its main domain, offers an interactive per-endpoint playground, and backs this with a published version policy, a Python SDK and a CLI. The probe 404s were on the docs domain only, while the spec is documented at www.datalab.to/openapi.json, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the hosted API end-to-end (community evidence covers only the open-source Marker library).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
